messages:
deploy-bot: initiating staged rollout: service=runtime-host version=4.0.0-quant -> initial 8% global (ap-south=4%, eu-west=2%, us-east=2%). change-window=2024-11-15T04:00Z. watch for memory and GPU-driver restarts. :rocket:
josh: picking up p95/p99 and node metrics. will flag if any reboots.
priya: ap-south node 3 showing kernel OOM events and nvidia-driver crashed 2x within last 90s. kubectl logs show: `kworker: Out of memory: Kill process 2345 (nvidia) score 987`.
ops-oncall: that's not good. what fraction of traffic is ap-south? 4% but concentrated on a few nodes.
dylan: looks related to new kernel allocation path in 4.0.0 quant kernels that map large pinned buffers. memory footprint jumped ~30% on those pods.
infra-sre: any earlier bench on memory footprint for quant vs baseline? we had perf numbers but maybe missed host-level allocs.
josh: perf microbench on staging showed peak mem +18% but didn't trigger OOM due to larger node sizes. prod nodes are on older instance types with tighter headroom.
ops-oncall: recommend PAUSE rollout and regional pin ap-south back to 3.9.7. avoid global rollback if possible.
deploy-bot: rollout status: 8% deployed. region breakdown: ap-south=4%, eu-west=2%, us-east=2%. To pause run: `/deploy pause --id=rollout-1769998880`
ops-oncall: running pause now.
ops-oncall: `/deploy pause --id=rollout-1769998880` -> accepted. applying route override: ap-south -> v3.9.7 (4%). initiating drain of affected pods.
deploy-bot: route override applied. ap-south pinned to v3.9.7. health checks passing. current global deployed fraction: 6%.
priya: after pin, kernel OOMs stopped. node 3 recovered and pods stabilized.
infra-sre: short term: adding a guardrail to preflight to fail bucketing on nodes with <X% free host memory when quant kernels enabled. long term: add allocation cap and better preflight on prod instance types.
release-eng: updating release notes: "v4.0.0-quant staged rollout paused due to increased host memory usage and driver OOMs in ap-south; ap-south pinned to v3.9.7. Follow-ups: diag quant allocation, preflight guards, and targeted canary on larger node types."
dylan: I'll open hotfix/rollback branch to temporarily disable new pinned buffer path and re-run staging mem tests. aiming for candidate in next 6 hours.
ops-oncall: once candidate ready, request 1% ap-south canary with 60m monitoring and gpu-driver watch. also consider draining to larger node shapes for canary.
josh: ack. logging action items in GH and tagging infra-sre for follow-up.
release-eng: will notify customers on apac dedicated clusters if needed. good catch.
ops-oncall: closing immediate action. reopen thread if we see escalation. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: rollout paused by ops-oncall. final status: ap-south pinned v3.9.7, global deployed fraction 6%.
